hook.en: Every morning you decide: if it is raining, take an umbrella, else leave it at home. A program makes decisions in the same way, using the if statement.
hook.kn: ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ನೀವು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತೀರಿ: ಮಳೆ ಬರುತ್ತಿದ್ದರೆ ಛತ್ರಿ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ, ಇಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ಬೇಡ. ಪ್ರೋಗ್ರಾಂ ಕೂಡ if ಹೇಳಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಹೀಗೆಯೇ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Define flow of control and name its three kinds
Trace the output of simple decision programs

narration.en: Every morning you decide: if it is raining, take an umbrella, else leave it at home. A program makes decisions in the same way, using the if statement.

body.en: The order in which the statements of a program are executed is called the flow of control. Python supports three kinds: sequence (statements run one after another, top to bottom), selection (a condition decides which block runs) and repetition (a block runs again and again).

narration.en: The order in which the statements of a program are executed is called the flow of control. Python supports three kinds: sequence (statements run one after another, top to bottom), selection (a condition decides which block runs) and repetition (a block runs again and again).
narration.kn: ಪ್ರೋಗ್ರಾಂನ ಹೇಳಿಕೆಗಳು ಕಾರ್ಯಗತಗೊಳ್ಳುವ ಕ್ರಮವನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣದ ಹರಿವು ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಪೈಥಾನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂರು ವಿಧಗಳಿವೆ: ಅನುಕ್ರಮ, ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ.

title.en: On the board: if..else as a flowchart

say.en: A decision is drawn as a diamond. The condition inside it is either True or False.
If the condition is True, we follow the True arrow and print Even.
If it is False, we follow the other arrow and print Odd. Only one of the two blocks ever runs.
Both paths join again, and the program continues with the next statement in sequence.
In Python: the keyword if, a condition, a colon, and an indented block. The same for else.

narration.en: Let us draw the if..else statement as a flowchart and see that only one branch runs.

body.en: The if statement runs a block only when its condition is True: if condition: followed by an indented block. The if..else statement chooses between two blocks: the if block runs when the condition is True, otherwise the else block runs. A condition is a Boolean expression built with relational operators such as >, <, ==, != and logical operators and, or, not.

points.en: if condition:  → block runs only when True
else:  → block runs when the condition is False
Colon at the end, block indented below

narration.kn: if ಹೇಳಿಕೆ ಷರತ್ತು ಸತ್ಯವಾದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಬ್ಲಾಕ್ ಅನ್ನು ಕಾರ್ಯಗತಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. if..else ಎರಡು ಬ್ಲಾಕ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದನ್ನು ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ: ಷರತ್ತು ಸತ್ಯವಾದರೆ if ಬ್ಲಾಕ್, ಇಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ else ಬ್ಲಾಕ್.

caption.en: The program tests num % 2 == 0. The remainder on division by 2 decides which branch of the if..else runs.

tryThis.en: Move num through 6, 7, 8. Which branch runs each time?
Is 0 even or odd according to the program?
Change the test to num % 5 == 0 in your head: which values would print the if branch?

narration.en: The program tests num % 2 == 0. The remainder on division by 2 decides which branch of the if..else runs. Move num through 6, 7, 8. Which branch runs each time?

problem.en: Write a program that prints the positive difference of two numbers num1 = 5 and num2 = 12 (the larger minus the smaller).

narration.en: The condition num1 greater than num2 is False, so the else block subtracts num1 from num2.

problem.en: A shop gives free delivery when the bill is ₹499 or more. Trace the program for bill = 650.

narration.en: Here there is no else: if the condition is False, the if block is simply skipped and charge stays 40.
Class quiz. Discuss with your neighbour, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪಕ್ಕದವರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Board exam pattern questions. Read every option before you choose.

points.en: Flow of control is the order in which statements are executed: sequence, selection, repetition.
if runs its block only when the condition is True.
points.kn: ಷರತ್ತು ಸತ್ಯವಾದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ if ಬ್ಲಾಕ್ ಕಾರ್ಯಗತವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: if..else runs exactly one of two blocks.
points.kn: if..else ಎರಡರಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದೇ ಬ್ಲಾಕ್ ಅನ್ನು ಕಾರ್ಯಗತಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: A colon ends the if/else line and the block below is indented.
points.kn: if/else ಸಾಲು ಕೋಲನ್‌ನಿಂದ ಕೊನೆಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ; ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಬ್ಲಾಕ್ ಇಂಡೆಂಟ್ ಆಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ.

homework.en: Write a program that reads a year and prints whether it is a leap year (divisible by 4 and not by 100, or divisible by 400).

narration.en: Recap. Flow of control is the order in which statements are executed: sequence, selection, repetition. if runs its block only when the condition is True. if..else runs exactly one of two blocks. A colon ends the if/else line and the block below is indented.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವಲೋಕನ. ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣದ ಹರಿವು: ಅನುಕ್ರಮ, ಆಯ್ಕೆ, ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಷರತ್ತು ಸತ್ಯವಾದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ if ಬ್ಲಾಕ್ ಕಾರ್ಯಗತವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. if..else ಎರಡರಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದೇ ಬ್ಲಾಕ್ ಅನ್ನು ಕಾರ್ಯಗತಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. if/else ಸಾಲು ಕೋಲನ್‌ನಿಂದ ಕೊನೆಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ; ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಬ್ಲಾಕ್ ಇಂಡೆಂಟ್ ಆಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ.
